captions.detailed: This 3D model is a model rocket nose cone. It features a smooth, parabolically curved upper nose section that tapers to a rounded point at the top. The base of the nose cone has a stepped-down cylindrical shoulder designed to fit snugly inside a rocket body tube. Inside the lower shoulder, there is a hollowed-out section with a transverse cylindrical pin designed for attaching a recovery shock cord.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric model rocket nose cone in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to adjust the inner tube radius, outer nose cone radius, and overall nose length. Include a bottom shoulder with a built-in shock cord attachment loop inside the hollow connector.
captions.factory: The code uses a union of two main sections: the lower connector shoulder and the upper aerodynamic nose. The lower shoulder is constructed from a slightly tapered cylinder. A rectangular cube and a cylinder are subtracted from this base cylinder to form a hollow chamber, and a small transverse cylinder is added back inside to serve as a cord attachment bar. The upper nose is generated by scaling a sphere along the Z-axis to match the desired length, and then cutting off the bottom half using a difference operation with a cube.
